entries.source: I will buy high quality for high price.

entries.source: on the dead body for a few seconds.

entries.source: Using magic to kill an animal burns the meat, reducing its quality to 0.
entries.translation: 使用魔法杀死动物会烧焦肉，使肉的品质降为 0。

entries.source: In Memory Of John Schwartz Better known as Iceman
entries.translation: 纪念约翰·施瓦茨，大家更熟悉的名字是 Iceman。

entries.source: Iceman was a pillar of the LOMCN community since he joined
entries.translation: Iceman 加入后一直是 LOMCN 社区的中坚力量，

entries.source: in 2003, He released multiple servers throughout his time with us.
entries.translation: 自 2003 年起，他在陪伴我们的岁月里发布了多个服务器。

entries.source: He created his own Mir 2 Files from Crystal and called it Eden Elite,
entries.translation: 他基于 Crystal 制作了自己的传奇 2 文件，并命名为 Eden Elite，

entries.source: the files have been used and will continue to be used by many.
entries.translation: 这些文件过去被许多人使用，未来也会继续如此。

entries.source: Giving hundreds around the globe enjoyment of a beloved game,
entries.translation: 让全球数百人享受这款深受喜爱的游戏。

entries.source: Sadly on 05/05/2023 at 4:12pm EST he passed away after a hard battle
entries.translation: 遗憾的是，在与病魔顽强抗争后，他于 05/05/2023 4:12pm EST 离世，

entries.source: Iceman was a kind and loving gentleman that will be missed by hundreds,
entries.translation: Iceman 是一位善良有爱的人，许多人都会怀念他，

entries.source: may he live on within our community.
entries.translation: 愿他的精神永存于我们的社区。

entries.source: From all of us at LOMCN,
We would like to send our love to his family and friends.
entries.translation: 向他的家人和朋友送上关爱与慰问。

entries.source: I will not speak to such a person like you.
entries.translation: 我不会和你这种人说话。

entries.translation: 你好，<$USERNAME>。我是行会领地管家。

entries.source: I want to <Extend/@extend> the rental period.

entries.translation: 我要把成员<召唤/@summon>到领地。

entries.translation: 我要<申请或取消/@appcancel>出售行会领地。

entries.source: I will summon the members scattered in the Mir continent now.
entries.translation: 我现在就召唤散布在传奇大陆各地的成员。

entries.source: To extend the rental period of this territory for 7 additional days.
entries.translation: 可将领地租期额外延长 7 天。

entries.source: After the rental period expiration, the guild is given 7 days
entries.translation: 租期结束后，行会还有 7 天时间

entries.source: to extend. If no fee is paid even within the additional 7 days,
entries.translation: 办理续租。如果额外 7 天内仍未缴费，

entries.source: the ownership of the guild territory will be completely removed.
entries.translation: 该行会将彻底失去领地所有权。

entries.source: I will start & cancel the sale of guild territory.
entries.translation: 我可以办理行会领地出售和取消出售。

entries.translation: 交易成功后，领地所有权将在

repair with this oil occasionally during hunting.

Hello traveller. How can i help you?
entries.translation: 你好，旅行者。需要什么帮助？
你有 <$PARCELAMOUNT> 个包裹等待领取。

entries.source: What item do you want to store or withdraw?
entries.translation: 你想存入或取出什么物品？

entries.source: How are you. <$USERNAME>. I am the 'Guild Territory Steward'.
entries.translation: 你好，<$USERNAME>。我是行会领地管家。

entries.source: I want to <Extend/@extend> the rental period.
I want to <Summon/@summon> members to the territory.
entries.translation: 我要把成员<召唤/@summon>到领地。

entries.source: I want to <Apply or Cancel/@appcancel> sale of my guild territory.
entries.translation: 我要<申请或取消/@appcancel>出售行会领地。

entries.source: I will summon the members scattered in the Mir continent now.
entries.translation: 我现在就召唤散布在传奇大陆各地的成员。

entries.source: To extend the rental period of this territory for 7 additional days.
entries.translation: 可将领地租期额外延长 7 天。

entries.source: After the rental period expiration, the guild is given 7 days
entries.translation: 租期结束后，行会还有 7 天时间

entries.source: to extend. If no fee is paid even within the additional 7 days,
entries.translation: 办理续租。如果额外 7 天内仍未缴费，

entries.source: the ownership of the guild territory will be completely removed.
entries.translation: 该行会将彻底失去领地所有权。

entries.source: I will start & cancel the sale of guild territory.
entries.translation: 我可以办理行会领地出售和取消出售。

entries.source: After a successful transaction, the ownership shall be
entries.translation: 交易成功后，领地所有权将在

entries.source: transferred to the buyer 24 hours later.

entries.translation: 你好，旅行者。需要什么帮助？

entries.source: What item would you like to buy or sell?

entries.translation: 以下是仍可回购的物品。

entries.source: You can repair various kinds of Torch's.
entries.translation: 这里可以修理各种火把。
我经营<蜡烛/@candle>、<地牢逃脱卷/@dungeonescape>、<随机传送卷/@randomteleport>、

entries.source: I have heard that there are <TownTeleport/@townteleport> which monsters
entries.translation: 听说怪物有时会掉落<回城卷/@townteleport>，

entries.source: Candles are needed when it's dark. Without a candle
entries.translation: 黑暗中需要蜡烛照明。没有蜡烛，

entries.source: A DungeonEscape scroll is a magic paper that moves you promptly
entries.translation: 地牢逃脱卷是一种魔法卷轴，可以迅速把你传送

entries.source: to certain fields near the last village you visited.
entries.translation: 传送到你最后到访村庄附近的指定区域。

entries.source: The power of Dungeonescape scroll is weak compared with
entries.translation: 地牢逃脱卷的力量不如

entries.source: TownTeleport scrolls but it could still save your life.
entries.translation: 回城卷，但它仍然能救你一命。

entries.source: A Randomteleport scroll is a magic paper that can
entries.translation: 随机传送卷是一种魔法卷轴，可以

entries.source: make you randomly move to another place in the same map.
entries.translation: 使你随机移动到当前地图的其他位置。

entries.source: For example if you were in a dungeon 1st floor, you will
entries.translation: 例如，当你身处地牢 1st 层时，可以用它

entries.source: move to another place on that floor by using the RT.
entries.translation: 使用随机传送卷可移动到同一层的其他位置。

entries.source: If the situation is dangerous but you still have potions, use this
entries.translation: 身处险境但仍有药水时，可以使用它

entries.source: to help you out of a tight situation.
A RepairOil makes the durability of your hand weapon rise.
entries.translation: 修理油可以恢复手中武器的持久。

entries.source: This oil doesn't special repair your weapon, so
entries.translation: 这种油并非特殊修理，使用后

entries.source: remember that the maximum durability of the weapon
entries.translation: 但请记住，武器的最高持久

entries.source: goes down as time goes by.
entries.translation: 会随着时间流逝而降低。

entries.source: If the weapon was not expensive,
repair with this oil occasionally during hunting.
entries.translation: 在狩猎途中偶尔可以用这种油修理武器。

entries.source: This will make hunts last longer.
entries.translation: 这样可以让狩猎持续更久。

entries.source: TownTeleport scrolls can't be made now because the ancient
entries.translation: 古代的制作技艺已经失传，现在无法制作回城卷，
这种制作技艺已经失传……不过……

entries.source: I have heard that they might come randomly from monsters
entries.translation: 听说它们可能会从怪物身上随机掉落。

entries.source: and you can return to a village promptly by using it...
entries.translation: 使用它便能迅速返回村庄……

entries.source: poverty. So, I would like to help them with my making skills.
entries.translation: 贫困。因此，我想用自己的制作技艺帮助他们。

entries.source: If you also want anything to be made, you may as well ask me.
entries.translation: 如果你想制作什么物品，尽管来找我。

entries.source: Please select the Recipe you either want to Buy or Sell.
entries.translation: 请选择你想购买或出售的配方。

entries.source: I am the Guild Territory Merchant and
I'm in charge of guild territory rent and sales.
entries.translation: 我负责行会领地的租用和出售。

entries.source: I want to <rent/@rent> a guild territory.
I want to <go/@move> to my guild territory.
entries.translation: 我要<前往/@move>我的行会领地。

entries.source: I want to check the <list/@agitbuy> of guild territories.
entries.translation: 我要查看行会领地<列表/@agitbuy>。

entries.source: I want to <trade/@trade> my guild territory.
Guild territory is an exclusive space for a guild,
entries.translation: 行会领地是行会专属的空间，

entries.source: where the members stay for privacy. Members of the
guild that has its own territory do not have
entries.translation: 拥有自己领地的行会无需

entries.source: to have secret meeting at the hidden corners of villages,
entries.translation: 在村庄隐蔽角落秘密会面，

entries.source: where privacy is still not guaranteed. Guild members may
entries.translation: 但隐私仍无法完全保证。行会成员可以

entries.source: have private conversations and socialize with other members.
entries.translation: 进行私密交谈，并与其他成员交流。

entries.source: In short, it is a residence for clans.
entries.translation: 简单来说，这就是行会驻地。

entries.source: You need 10,000,000 {金币/Gold} to rent a guild territory and the initial
entries.translation: 租用行会领地需要 10,000,000 {金币/Gold}，初始

entries.source: If you want to extend, talk to the 'GT Steward' in the territory.
entries.translation: 如需续租，请与领地内的行会领地管家交谈。

entries.source: After paying the fee of 1,000,000 {金币/Gold},
the rent will be extended for an additional 7 days.
entries.translation: 租期将额外延长 7 天。

entries.source: Do you still want to rent a territory? <Rent/@agitreg> <Cancel/@exit>
entries.translation: 你仍要租用领地吗？<租用/@agitreg> <取消/@exit>

entries.source: Then I will teleport you to the territory of you guild.
entries.translation: 之后我会把你传送到所属行会的领地。

entries.source: However, only the guild masters or the members who
entries.translation: 不过，只有行会会长或所属行会

entries.source: have their own territories can be transported.
entries.translation: 拥有领地的成员才能被传送。

entries.source: If you wish to return to castles or villages, look
entries.translation: 如果想返回城堡或村庄，请寻找

entries.source: for the Armed Transporter at the entrance of the
entries.translation: 在入口处寻找武装传送员，地点是

entries.source: Do you want to move to the guild territory? <Move/@agitmove> <Cancel/@exit>
entries.translation: 要移动到行会领地吗？<移动/@agitmove> <取消/@exit>

entries.source: Here, you can see all the information about ownership, trades,
entries.translation: 你可以在这里查看领地所有权、交易、

entries.source: and sales of guild territories at once. If you intend to
entries.translation: 以及领地出售信息。如果你打算

entries.source: purchase a guild territory from the list, send a 'note'
entries.translation: 从列表中购买行会领地，并发送一条“留言”

entries.source: to the guild master who owns the territory. And if you wish to
entries.translation: 交给拥有该领地的行会会长。如果你想

entries.source: purchase the guild territory after reaching agreement,
entries.translation: 达成协议后购买行会领地，

entries.source: use the 'trade' menu of the main screen.
entries.translation: 使用主界面的“交易”菜单。

entries.source: By facing the guild master and selecting 'trade',
entries.translation: 面向行会会长并选择“交易”，

entries.source: the transaction is complete. After a successful transaction,
entries.translation: 交易即告完成。交易成功后，

entries.source: the ownership is transferred in 24 hours and the previous owners
entries.translation: 所有权将在 24 小时后转移，原领地成员

entries.source: are automatically 'kicked out' from the territory.
So, please think carefully berfore trading the guild territory.
entries.translation: 因此，在交易行会领地前请慎重考虑。
要进行交易吗？<交易/@agittrade> <取消/@exit>

entries.source: I will not speak to such a person like you.
entries.translation: 我不会和你这种人说话。

entries.source: Hello, Do you want to play a game?
All you have to do is guess what number I'm thinking
entries.translation: 你只要猜出我心里想的数字。

entries.source: If you guess correctly you will be gifted 100,000 {金币/GOLD}
entries.translation: 如果猜对，你将获得 100,000 {金币/GOLD}。

entries.source: However if you guess wrongly you will lose 10,000 {金币/GOLD}
entries.translation: 不过，如果猜错，你将失去 10,000 {金币/GOLD}。

entries.source: Congratulations, you Won! Enjoy your 100,000 {金币/GOLD} Coins.
entries.translation: 恭喜，你赢了！请收下 100,000 {金币/GOLD}。

entries.source: Unfortunately you lost, better luck next time.
entries.translation: 很遗憾，你输了。下次好运。

entries.source: How can I be of assistance.
These are the items still available to purchase back.
entries.translation: 以下是仍可回购的物品。

entries.translation: 把需要修理的武器给我看看。

entries.translation: 把需要修理的武器给我看看。

entries.source: I can send you several places nearby.
entries.translation: 我可以送你去附近的几个地方。

entries.source: Welcome, What can I do for you?
entries.translation: 欢迎光临，需要什么帮助？

entries.source: These are the items still available to purchase back.
entries.translation: 以下是仍可回购的物品。

entries.source: You can repair various kinds of Bracelets and Gloves.
entries.translation: 这里可以修理各种手镯和手套。

entries.source: Welcome, what can I do for you?
entries.translation: 欢迎光临，需要什么帮助？

entries.source: I will buy high quality for high price.
entries.translation: 品质越好的肉，我给的价格越高。

entries.source: but if the meat is stained with soil or burned with fire
entries.translation: 但如果肉沾了泥土或被火烧焦，

entries.source: I'll buy it at low price.
Meat can be gained from {Hens/Crimson}, {Deer/Crimson}, {Sheep/Crimson}, and {Wolves/Crimson}.
entries.translation: 可从{鸡/Crimson}、{鹿/Crimson}、{羊/Crimson}和{狼/Crimson}身上取得肉。

entries.source: To get meat from any of the above, first of all kill the animal.
entries.translation: 要从上述动物身上取得肉，首先要杀死动物。

entries.source: Once you have killed it, press the ALT button, while left clicking
entries.translation: 杀死动物后，按住 Alt 键并点击鼠标左键

entries.source: on the dead body for a few seconds.
You should then see a piece of meat appear in your inventory.
entries.translation: 随后，你会看到一块肉出现在背包中。

entries.source: Using magic to kill an animal burns the meat, reducing its quality to 0.
entries.translation: 使用魔法杀死动物会烧焦肉，使肉的品质降为 0。
